notes.title: Update - Version 1.0.7.3
notes.notes:
This is the list of changes that have been applied in this update:

- Adjustments to flying enemies' AI
- Fixed bug that allowed mid-air jumping following the aerial variation of the attack which launched enemies upward (Up + Attack)
